name: nextmap
description: 3D alpine map for Tyrol: tiris laser-scan terrain, summer/winter imagery and crawled hiking and ski-touring routes

scripts.dev: npm run build && (npm run watch & node --env-file-if-exists=.env --watch-path=server --watch-path=shared server/index.js)
scripts.deploy: npm run build:static && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name nextmap --branch main
